GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 332.1 (16 Nov 46) GA
(SCAPIN-1343)
APO 500
16 November 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Hoisting of National Flag.
1. There is no objection to the display of the Japanese national flag on 23 November 1946 as requested by C.L.O. No. 5969 (PHW-P) dated 12 November 1946, subject as above.
2. Occupation troops will be informed in this matter.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
